faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about EnglishForce

whatIsEnglishForce.question: What is EnglishForce?
whatIsEnglishForce.answer: EnglishForce is an AI-powered online English learning platform offering courses, practice tests, structured learning programs, and an AI chatbot for personalized learning support. We help learners improve all four skills: listening, speaking, reading, and writing.

whoIsItFor.question: Who is EnglishForce for?
whoIsItFor.answer: EnglishForce is suitable for all levels from beginner to advanced. Whether you're preparing for TOEIC, improving conversational English, or learning English for specific purposes, we have content for you.

howToGetStarted.question: How do I get started?
howToGetStarted.answer:
1. Create a free account
2. Explore free courses
3. Join structured learning programs
4. Purchase premium courses for full access
5. Use the AI chatbot for daily practice

howToPurchase.question: How do I purchase a course?
howToPurchase.answer:
You can purchase courses by:
1. Browse courses on the Courses page
2. Click 'Add to Cart'
3. Go to cart and checkout via Stripe
4. After successful payment, the course appears in 'My Learning'

refundPolicy.question: What is the refund policy?
refundPolicy.answer: We offer a 7-day refund policy if you haven't completed more than 20% of the course. Contact support@englishforce.com to request a refund.

courseAccess.question: Do I have lifetime access to courses?
courseAccess.answer: Yes! After purchasing, you have lifetime access to the course, including all future updates.

certificate.question: Will I receive a certificate?
certificate.answer: Yes, after completing the course and achieving a minimum score of 70%, you'll receive a downloadable certificate of completion.

examTypes.question: What types of exams are available?
examTypes.answer:
EnglishForce offers:
- TOEIC practice tests (Listening & Reading)
- Placement tests to assess your level
- Final course exams
- Topic-based tests (Grammar, Vocabulary, etc.)

retake.question: Can I retake exams?
retake.answer: Yes, you can retake exams unlimited times. Each attempt is saved in your history and you can review detailed results.

toeicPrep.question: Does EnglishForce help with TOEIC preparation?
toeicPrep.answer:
Yes! We have a specialized TOEIC preparation program with:
- Practice tests in real TOEIC format
- All 7 Parts (Listening & Reading)
- Detailed explanations for each question
- Structured learning path by part

difference.question: What's the difference between Courses and Programs?
difference.answer:
- Courses: Independent video-based courses by topic (paid)
- Programs: Structured learning with Units → Lessons → Exercises (free)

Programs are great for building foundations, Courses for in-depth learning.

progress.question: How do I track my progress?
progress.answer:
Go to your Profile page to see:
- Number of lessons completed
- Average scores for Programs and Exams
- Exam score chart over time
- Detailed statistics for each program

forgotPassword.question: I forgot my password, what should I do?
forgotPassword.answer:
1. Click 'Forgot Password?' on the login page
2. Enter your email
3. Receive OTP code via email
4. Enter OTP and create new password

changeEmail.question: How do I change my email?
changeEmail.answer:
1. Go to Profile page
2. Click 'Set / Change Email'
3. Verify OTP sent to old email (if exists)
4. Enter new email and verify OTP
5. New email will be updated

deleteAccount.question: Can I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: Yes, you can request account deletion by contacting support@englishforce.com. Note that all data and learning progress will be permanently deleted.

browserSupport.question: Which browsers does EnglishForce support?
browserSupport.answer:
EnglishForce works best on:
- Google Chrome (latest version)
- Mozilla Firefox (latest version)
- Safari (latest version)
- Microsoft Edge (latest version)

mobileApp.question: Is there a mobile app?
mobileApp.answer: EnglishForce is currently developing a mobile app. You can access via browser on your phone with a responsive experience.

videoNotPlaying.question: Videos won't play, what should I do?
videoNotPlaying.answer:
Try:
1. Check internet connection
2. Refresh the page (F5)
3. Clear browser cache and cookies
4. Try a different browser
5. If still not working, contact support

chatbot.question: What can the AI Chatbot help me with?
chatbot.answer:
EnglishForce's AI Chatbot can:
- Answer grammar and vocabulary questions
- Explain exercises and test questions
- Practice English conversation
- Suggest appropriate learning materials
- Correct errors and provide feedback

recommendations.question: How does the recommendation system work?
recommendations.answer:
Our AI system analyzes:
- Your learning history
- Scores and progress
- Preferences and goals

Based on this, it recommends courses and exercises suitable for your level and needs.
